test_title: PYST 3: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 02 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.**

I have been in Chennai __since__ a week, but I am planning to return now.
solution:
The correct answer is: **for**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The use of "**since**" in the original sentence is incorrect because "**since**" is typically used to refer to a specific point in time, indicating when something started.
 
• When expressing a duration of time, "**for**" is the appropriate preposition to use.
